title: If you ever get the chance to join with farmworkers seeking justice …

body:
… take it. Get a flavor of a recent gathering with the Coalition of Immokalee Workers here:

 http://www.allianceforfairfood.org/news/2017/7/31/make-us-hungry-and-thirsty-for-justice-report-interfaith-service-and-action-for-farmworker-justice

 How good and how pleasant it is when people of different faiths come together seeking justice for the hard workers whose labor produces the food we all eat, whatever our religion.
